en.bdb: When it was pleasing to the Perfect True Guru,
then I chanted the Naam, the Name of the Pervading Lord.
The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,
The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.

verse.unicode: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jo ichheh soiee fal paaveh birathee aas na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: kirapaa kare jis praanapat dhaataa soiee sa(n)t gun gaavai ||

en.bdb: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: prem bhagat taa kaa man leenaa paarabraham man bhaavai ||2||

en.bdb: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਰਵਣਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਥੀ ॥

transliteration.english: aaTh pahar har kaa jas ravanaa bikhai Thagauree laathee ||

en.bdb: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison does not affect him.

verse.unicode: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਥੀ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: sa(n)g milai leeaa merai karatai sa(n)t saadh bhe saathee ||3||

en.bdb: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become my companions. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: kar geh leene sarabas dheene aapeh aap milaiaa ||

en.bdb: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything, and blended me with Himself.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੭੯॥

transliteration.english: kahu naanak sarab thok pooran pooraa satigur paiaa ||4||15||79||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, everything has been perfectly resolved; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||79||
